item.title: Show HN: Personal AI tutor that builds and probes your understanding
item.description:
I used to learn from books and courses. But I kept realising I hadn't built a real mental model. I always needed an LLM on the side to fill in what the books skipped. So, I stopped using books as my direct source of truth and started using LLMs itself: to design the curriculum and probe whether I understood the topic.

Suki - it's opensource. Given a topic it builds a curriculum from beginner to advanced, then probes your understanding chapter by chapter.

Link - https://github.com/grandimam/suki

Let me know what you guys think about it.

item.title: Ask HN: AI-Haters and AI-Usage
item.description:
Hey HN, so I got a few friends that completely hate on AI, which I partially get, AI-Art is taking jobs and looks ugly, but what is too much for you and how much AI do y'all use? Id like to understand the people that hate on AI, but most of the time their arguments are water usage, tho they all eat meat and buy new clothes which can be read about here https://bryantresearch.co.uk/insight-items/comparing-water-footprint-ai/

Also another question would be if being vegan/vegetarian would make AI usage less 'bad', or if its just a general hate
